notes.title: Saga of Sins is now available!

[h2]Happy Launch Day
[/h2]

Unbelievable! Today truly is the release of Saga of Sins, not only on Steam and Steam Deck but on console as well: PS5, PS4, Switch, XSX.

Fife years have passed from the first idea until the release of Saga of Sins and it was not always an easy journey.

As developers we are thankful for everyone in the team who put their heart and soul into this, for the great cooperation with our publisher Just For Games and last but not least the funding we got from the FFF Bavaria and the BMWK of the German government.

Your team at Bonus Level Entertainment

notes.title: Dev Diary #11: Wrath: The final of the seven deadly sins!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42811081/fa1252671549dd3d38d4dfa2c2c5a166bcfb530c.png[/img]

[h2]The final of the seven deadly sins: Wrath 
[/h2]
So, this is it, the final dev diary before our launch next week! Exciting times :) 

Wrath. Was it not Wrath that convinced our avatar Cecil to join the crusade and slay men in the name of his faith before returning to Sinwell? What else could have possessed him to think the deaths of others would be righteous? 

Or revenge. In some cultures, revenge is seen as a just cause. But isn’t it merely wrath in disguise?

And don’t we all get angry every now and then, maybe saying things we regret a minute later, once our rage has cooled off? 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42811081/ce58296dd8ca140eb22d637f199e44a1a819bfd4.png[/img]
z
[h3]The definition of Wrath
[/h3]
Ira: Wrath is the uncontrolled feeling of anger, rage, and hatred, that often manifests itself in the wish to seek vengeance. Patience cures wrath.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42811081/d50eba24120cae65088e830f6dcaa6ff2a13749b.png[/img]

[h3]A deadly sin spread across Sinwell
[/h3]
As Wrath is such a “common” sin, it is spread across all sorts of different villagers in Sinwell and it may surprise you who is guilty once you have tracked them down.

The setting for this deadly sin is a deep, gloomy dungeon featuring medieval instruments of torture, lots of climbable walls for the Griffin. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42811081/f77308b51becbd012437b965690662db366f9761.png[/img]

Finally the Taurus was used as design element, as you can see below in some of the concepts that were crafted for the Wrath level by the art team.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42811081/c66a3b2a8978416298c666f3a9cb583954de0c5b.png[/img]

Thank you for checking out this final deadly sin’s dev diary and please spread the word!
Your team at Bonus Level Entertainment :)

notes.title: Dev Diary #10: Pride: The sixth of the seven deadly sins
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42811081/d456f0a9ff8c29f1bb8addb809bb50927170b90b.png[/img]

[h2]The sixth of the seven deadly sins: Pride 
[/h2]
How can Pride be a sin, a deadly one even? Are you not proud of your retro collection, reaching level 100 in your favorite RPG or beating that super hard souls-like boss? Are we gamers especially guilty of Pride? Certainly not! And why should one not be proud of achieving things? 

The problem comes when Pride makes you think that you are the superior, better than others, not respecting or even listing to other opinions anymore, when it transforms into arrogance.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42811081/977e289d3e1fa409d9ac0729fdfc0b7780510f5e.png[/img]

[h3]The definition of Pride
[/h3]
Superbia: Pride is considered the most demonic of the seven deadly sins, an irrational belief that one is superior to others. Humility heals pride.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42811081/80cfba194b29bf466a4df9869b7fd5adbc6184b4.png[/img]

[h3]Waltz with me
[/h3]
Even if it is historically not 100% correct - but hey, we are inside of people’s minds - the stage for Pride is an opera house gone ballistic, including a nice ¾ Waltz song to roll with.

Mirrors and giant chandeliers play an important role in this one and a peacock is the signature enemy. And have you ever asked yourself, what lies behind the reflections you see in a mirror?

Below are the concepts for the “Ballroom” and the bottomless “Chandelier Attic” two of the three sections we came up with for this deadly sin. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42811081/8047ed01f8a3a59fcfd2a919e0528477483eb179.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42811081/7b47de89056a20d8a71f78218498439ba0057253.png[/img]

To be honest we really put a lot of effort into these levels and we are certainly proud of how they turned out… proud in a good way, that is ;)

We hope you enjoyed our dev diary. Just one more deadly sin to go!
Your team at Bonus Level Entertainment

notes.title: Dev Diary #9 : Envy : Beware of your desire...
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42811081/ac1fc847da4b96d56f019f9ea59260f66e0584b4.png[/img]

[h2]The fifth of the seven deadly sins: Envy 
[/h2]
“Does envy not have its uses? If we never sought the good others have, aren't we doomed to misery?”

What do you think? Can Envy actually lead to better results? If you are striving for more but the original motive is a negative one - such as the deadly sins Envy - is your outcome by definition a bad one?

[h3]The definition of Envy
[/h3]
Invidia: Envy can be described as a resentful covetousness towards the traits or possessions of someone else, arising from vainglory. Kindness cures envy.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42811081/cff7eb87ca03ef4e91261b48f292a6dee3f28bf5.png[/img]

[h3]Inside their minds
[/h3]
In Sinwell some of the villagers are amongst the artist guild. Painters and sculptors are all part of the same community, with the skilled but jealous Hieronymus being their leader. Envy has spread across them and so their minds are a mix between an artist’s studio and a tower - to manifest “striving for more” and thus climbing up or down “the ladder”. 

In the first Envy level, the according villager can even be seen in the oil painting that is hanging in the back of the level’s wall.

The Feet Demon is also first introduced in this level. Sometimes its little descendants are following him, perfect for Power Dash combos and extra coins…

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42811081/f66b47bbe3375c4953901db35b7c815dc301c92a.png[/img]

[h3]Speedrun incoming!
[/h3]
Contrary to the first level that goes from top to bottom, the second Envy level needs to be climbed up. But do not worry, we placed many trampolines here and so it became THE Saga of Sins Speedrun level per definition, including lots of Dash Doves to instantly refill your Dash Meter and thus enabling a super-fast playstyle. More on this topic after launch!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42811081/99130010156ea2234c8cadca3358a45108fd6c3c.png[/img]

Feel free to leave a comment and thank you for your support,
Your team at Bonus Level Entertainment :)

notes.title: Dev Diary #8 : Lust - Happy Valentine's Day ♥
notes.notes:
[h1]Happy Valentine’s Day![/h1]

First of all, thank you to everyone who have tried our demo during Steam Next Fest. We had a blast streaming and answering your questions and we're happy that you liked our demo! The demo is still available if you want to fight and discover our beloved Gluttonny...

Today, we cannot miss to speak about one of our sins because Feb 14th date is dedicated to him... or almost... Lust! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42811081/192e9f7a1bf9a0121744949cdefd1a09c905888f.png[/img]

[h3]The fourth of the seven deadly sins: Lust [/h3]

No, we are not being sarcastic, it is Valentine’s Day today! This day is about love… and flowers! Or flowers and love, but either way you put it, they are somehow connected to each other so we decided to cater to that cliché.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42811081/68e7ede63013cfd1f6d83db8fecf23f47c5bbe1a.jpg[/img]

[h3]The definition of Lust[/h3]

Lust, Luxuria in old Latin, stands for overly intense longing, an unbridled desire for satisfaction and the impurity of thought. Decency cures lust.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42811081/f31ac6cd51692fe45b295df3fec12314a13f7d69.png[/img]

[h3]The story of flowers and bees[/h3]

In order to not get an 18+ rating we went for the charming “flowers and bees” story. However, it was not an easy task to get the art right for bees kissing flowers when both are made of stained glass. We hope you like the result as much as we do.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42811081/a631781836f422c66feed1d0c6326fc5479e6d3a.png[/img]

For the Lust level setting we chose an oversized meadow with occasional beehives and some suggestively shaped objects, also taking a bit of inspiration from the famous painting 'Garden of Lust' by Hieronymus Bosch (1450-1516).

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42811081/dfb0e2a85615fcdcf3ea2f2fa819b9a9f2738532.png[/img]

[h2]What boss could that bee?[/h2]

Well, no spoilers here ;) But rest assured, this boss does not celebrate Valentine’s Day...

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42811081/429db42de66ee305a20d568499d0ffe81be81eb8.png[/img]


Thank you for checking out our dev diary and take care,
Your team at Bonus Level Entertainment :)

notes.title: Steam Demo Fest & Exclusive interview from Rupert Ochsner!
notes.notes:
[h1]Steam Demo Fest is starting![/h1]

First of all, thank you for the kind words about the demo release a couple of days ago.
Starting today, we have the honor to be featured on this year’s Steam Demo Fest :) 
You can play the first chapter of Saga of Sins for free.
Tell us what you think :)

Download the demo [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2094550/Saga_of_Sins/]right here![/url]

Saga of Sins' game director, Rupert Ochsner, will be live on [u][b]Tuesday 7th, 6pm CET[/b][/u] to play the demo and answer questions!
A complete interview from Rupert Ochsner will also be broadcasted later this week! Stay tuned for the exact date!

[h1]How to advance in Saga of Sins![/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42811081/b38f7921b9bb72365a29b6a81c335e1a1df73be9.png[/img]

[h2]Story Arcade[/h2]

We at Bonus Level like to describe Saga of Sins as a “Story Arcade” game. A title that combines arcade style gameplay - featuring lots of secrets and some RPG elements - with a meaningful story of inner conflict, twists and multiple endings, as well as a fresh take on progression.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42811081/9291a1a5a17932abacc310f01aa89a38f1f8fb0f.png[/img]

[h2]Enter their minds[/h2]

As you already know our hero Cecil needs to enter the minds the villagers of Sinwell - in the form of a demonic creature such as a Werewolf, Gargoyle or Griffin - to fight the seven deadly sins and thus free his home village from the plague.

And it will be up to you in which order you want to enter the people’s minds and progress through the game! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42811081/dbfd91290c54310d637ba8a371b505c09a24a808.png[/img]

[h2]Track down the sinners[/h2]

To make this task a convenient one, Cecil carries a notebook that he uses for tracking down the sinners and innocent.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42811081/e7ee4e6afa06aa0d2902d8bfb0b7046a3cb6c6b5.png[/img]

[h2]Gluttony: Levels[/h2]

The villagers Brom and Glutwin for example are never sober, so when entering their minds, you will find yourself inside one of two Gluttony levels, a tavern gone mad!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42811081/a58820ceefd3424eb423abb1eb2dfea924f14f9d.jpg[/img]

[h2]Gluttony: Boss[/h2]

The third mind of a villager guilty of the same deadly sin will have you face that deadly sin’s boss.

So, we have two action levels and one boss battle per deadly sin, resulting in three villager’s minds that need to entered for each of the seven deadly sins!

But be warned, you can only access the boss level of a deadly sin once you have cleared the two according action levels first. In which order is entirely up to you.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42811081/8cf69d8cca725539b75d2aecc8d2cdea5eaa5538.png[/img]

[h2]Innocent villagers[/h2]

Last but not least, Sinwell is also inhabitant by innocent people. Their minds do not necessarily need to be entered to finish the game (and thus see the two regular endings), but they do contain valuable loot that will aid you on your quest.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42811081/c9417bb718765a0a8c2b2d3057508f194d9c42fd.png[/img]

However, if you want to see the two true endings, all secrets need to be uncovered. And some of them may as well be buried deep within the minds of innocent villagers…

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42811081/4df28257f91ded097a80bd912ea00fc04968081c.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42811081/09ce89bb03be5bcb667e2f9345a13b4863f7df11.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42811081/de6b9827ff155d1acee31191566e0f04b936658b.jpg[/img]

[h2][b]And don’t forget:[/b][/h2]
[h3]You can try out Saga of Sins yourself right now on the Steam Demo Fest. Enjoy! Will you be brave enough to defeat Hogissimus?[/h3]

Thank you and please leave a comment,
Your team at Bonus Level Entertainment :)

notes.title: Dev Diary #6: Sloth, Demo Available Now, Launch Date
notes.notes:
First of all, a big thank you to everyone for following our dev diaries and updates! Today is a very special day because... we're launching the [u][b]Saga of Sins Demo!
[/b][/u]

That's right, you can have a try on the very first chapter of the game right NOW! Enter the minds of villagers guilty of Gluttony for the very first time and cast out our first boss, the piggish Hogissimus!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42811081/414d0b432700d673fd30d4b4c98013275e65a712.png[/img]

[h3]Saga of Sins will be released on [u][b]March 30,2023. [/b][/u][/h3]

The wait is almost over!

[i]Let's talk about Sloth for now![/i]

[h1][b]The third of the seven deadly sins: Sloth [/b][/h1]

Sloth is the most deceiving of sins, don’t you agree? What harm could lie in doing nothing? But when you are damned if you act, damned if you don't, what avenue is left but certain damnation? Well, let’s not overcomplete it, a nice dash combo on these zombie devils will make up for being lazy…

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42811081/f11c43e515bdaa1a78d90d0020bb1bca925c08d0.png[/img]

[h2]The definition of Sloth[/h2]

Sloth, Acedia in old Latin, is defined as a lack of vitality, a neglect of duties and the failure to do things that one should do. Diligence cures sloth.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42811081/d4a1148d8ba3adac1662f70b50fb8bf1c700cdec.png[/img]

[h2]Welcome to our Swampyard[/h2]

The setting for the two Sloth levels and the Sloth boss is muddy swamps, swamps filled with gravestones, bone crushing mills and a forest in the background with treetops resembling the shape of wolves.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42811081/33bb9f30f1e8caa251da859497d9824396f96ff0.png[/img] 

And what better enemy could await you here than a freakish maggot, with lanterns on its two heads, shooting slime and melee-attacking with its sickle-shaped claws should you ever dare coming too close!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42811081/c9d44fd4a3f266c3b270fe12ac2aba15d01a3b77.png[/img]

[h2]Boss: Insomnium[/h2]

The sloth boss on the other hand is, well, guilty of Sloth. It is the mind of the healer Durwin who refuses to help the poor villagers haunted by the plague. So, once you enter his mind you will find yourself inside his own little nightmare.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42811081/fbacc994bd4662d2fb30bd666deacd4153b4635a.png[/img]

We hope you like what we came up with for this deadly sin! Thank you for your support and feel free to leave a comment,
Your team at Bonus Level Entertainment :)

notes.title: Dev Diary #5 : Greed Reveal : The second of the seven deadly sins
notes.notes:
In a striking way, Greed may simply be connected to the act of stealing, but it is more than that and not always so easy to detect.

Is Greed not merely the struggle to strive for better? Would you survive the winter, had you not hoarded crops over the summer?

[h3]The definition of Greed[/h3]

Greed, Avaritia in old Latin, is a sin of desire, an artificial, rapacious pursuit of material possessions and hoarding of objects. Charity cures greed.

In Saga of Sins, we decided to portray Greed as catacombs overflowing with a deadly river of gold and waterfalls made of coins. And what enemies could be a better match than bats with a body shaped like a wallet, water devils and, well, gold fish.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42811081/cb81e62fd94947b8d7c41533569ffd1d56916a58.png[/img]

Even more, in order to hold up a mirror to yourself we have implemented dark coins that will drain gold from your wallet when picked up! Defeated enemies and special evil chests spawn these dark coins. However, they will not be affected by your coin magnet to make sure you do not pick them up by accident. 

As you can see, we mean it and Greed must be purged at all costs!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42811081/a90090c4b468c307947d35d6987eaf0f059e5f1e.png[/img]

[h3]Boss: Aurundam[/h3]

Don’t worry, we will not spoil every boss in our dev diaries but know that we are trying to offer as much variety as we possibly can. So, the boss of the deadly sins Greed is, contrary to the Hogissimus of Gluttony, an escape boss: a giant deadly wave of loot that you need to run away from. Enjoy!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42811081/ecc9ddcfa23e557aec001550629125927fc88fc7.png[/img]

Thank you for supporting us and please leave a comment or question,
Your team at Bonus Level Entertainment :)

notes.title: Dev Diary #4 : The third transformation...The mighty Griffin!
notes.notes:
[h2][b]The mighty Griffin[/b][/h2]

[h3]Switch to Griffin[/h3]
This ancient demon stands for loyalty and trust, but is all the more unforgiving when spotting sinners with its sharp eyes. Were it for this demonic creature's appetite for the human liver, our humble hero Cecil would not even feel that bad having to transform into it when entering the minds of the 31 villagers of Sinwell.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42811081/63236064f101ab337782f9203e89f238688912e1.png[/img]

Once again, you can switch between all creatures on the fly and there will be some optional yet rewarding backtracking.


[h3]Spread Shot[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42811081/eff1625dc0443c7d422f7c6af6f6664fc3d8b7c7.png[/img]

The Griffin features a spread shot that can be upgraded by donating gold to Madonna statues. Upgraded from two to four projectiles at once! This makes him super powerful for combat. So, make sure to collect lots of treasure chests and perform your Power Dash on multiple enemies, as this will make them drop twice as much gold!

[h3]Wall Cling[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42811081/8aee60e711d2d867a7af9a8f23aee09095743bd1.png[/img]

Only the mighty Griffin can climb special walls covered in vines to reach new heights, discover secrets or outflank enemies. 

[h3]Gameplay is King[/h3]
Each of our demonic creatures features a different shot type and skill. The Werewolf has a Revelation Howl that can shatter cracked glass, the Gargoyle’s Ignition can burn obstacles and light braziers to solve riddles and the Griffin uses a Wall Cling.

But what about speed, jump height and velocity? 

With the Gargoyle and the Griffin, we have two winged creatures, one rather strong the other rather fragile, does this affect the basic platforming gameplay at all? The simple answer is: no. But for a good reason!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42811081/b8ca7c01a7acc4ee2b56b106305426269176367b.png[/img]

The original plan actually was, that only the winged creatures can perform their Power Dash in midair, while the Werewolf can only do a Power Dash when standing on the ground. Same goes for the double ump.

In our prototype phase however, we found out that these feel rather unintuitive. Same goes for the already implemented and then scrapped different walk speeds, for example to make the Gargoyle feel more like a tank. 

At the end a fluid gameplay was more important for us than a forced individuality that sometimes felt inconvenient during combat or platforming…

Thank you for your passion and support,
Your team at Bonus Level Entertainment :)

notes.title: Dev Diary #3 : Gargoyle Reveal : 2nd transformation!
notes.notes:
[h2][b]The fierce Gargoyle[/b][/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42811081/c594cb2078fb5da5aa6ff97d6b5163ba63364e7e.png[/img]

[h3]Look up![/h3]
Have you ever stood in front of a cathedral, looking up, wondering what on earth these gruesome demons are doping on a scared building like this? Somehow contradictory, right? And thus, perfectly fitting as avatar for Saga of Sins!

“[i]In architecture, and specifically Gothic architecture, a Gargoyle is a carved or formed grotesque with a spout designed to convey water from a roof and away from the side of a building, thereby preventing it from running down masonry walls and eroding the mortar between.[/i]” (Wikipedia)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42811081/67e03c575e1742c4015c61c7c37f5137d03d9b61.png[/img]

But why did the architects not use the design of angels or saints? Well, because these Gargoyles may also scare and turn away evil influences. Just like our fire-breathing avatar, the second of the four Demonic Creatures you get to play. Once unlocked you can switch between the Werewolf and the Gargoyle on the fly. 

[h3]Fire Breath[/h3]
As this fierce demon is known for protecting sacred places from evil powers as well as for water fountains coming out of its mouth on rainy days, what could be more fitting than a flame thrower type of shot? We agree that its range is nothing compared to the Werewolf’s Triple Shot, but it is extremely useful against flying enemies and for powerful melee attacks. The length of the flame can be upgraded and certain objects, such as piles of boxes can be set on fire to clear the path or reach secret areas.

 [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42811081/c9cc6557087d29e83fbb4c12948ad5e400d64b99.png[/img]

[h3]Ignition[/h3]
Furthermore, special braziers can be set on fire with the Gargoyle’s Fire Breath! There will be different types of braziers, so for example sometimes you will need to light them in the correct order to make a treasure chest appear. Timed braziers, on the other hand, will force you to act swiftly before they go out again.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42811081/32d542bb28b049b483ae4a147e7317c06053b687.png[/img]

[h3]More to come…[/h3]
Below you can find some concepts and color variations of our Gargoyle. Two more demonic creatures will be playable and we will reveal the third one rather soon, but what could it be? Feel free to take a guess in the comments below!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42811081/790d8fcb2858d3f95e18ba1b60984d4070327007.png[/img]

Thank you for your interest in Saga of Sins,
Your team at Bonus Level Entertainment :)

notes.title: Dev Diary #2 : Gluttony Reveal: First of the seven deadly sins!
notes.notes:
[h2][b]The Seven Deadly Sins: Gluttony[/b][/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42811081/43a8ec5491421dd452be1cb29afd761c9c458396.png[/img]

In order to free your plague infested village, you will need to enter people’s minds to hunt down and fight the seven deadly sins.
As our hero Cecil returns to his home village of Sinwell right after the night of the annual founding festival, it is no surprise that the deadly sin Gluttony has yet stricken again.

In Saga of Sins, each of the seven deadly sins will be featured by two action and one boss level.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42811081/a1be06af962e0d326348fc51ab317b1a6465bf5c.png[/img]

[h3][b]The definition of Gula[/b][/h3]

[i]Gluttony, Gula in old Latin, represents an excessive craving for food, drink or wealth. It is the overconsumption of anything to the point of waste. Temperance cures Gluttony.[/i]

As you can see above, Gluttony manifested itself in the minds of the according sinners as a medieval tavern gone wild! 
Humans turned into feasting pigs, little devils are swinging on chandeliers dropping toxic liquid and the innkeepers are throwing around barrels of beverages.
The idea of a red devil tormenting a pig by pouring acid in its mouth is actually inspired by the amazing triptych “Last Judgment” by Hieronymus Bosch, that was created around 1485.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42811081/bfe60117dc01955e83ef2d6fd5383a79a2eed998.png[/img]

[h3][b]Gluttony Assets[/b][/h3]

Below you can find some of the assets we created to decorate the Gluttony levels.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42811081/b3ede34b3cec6a9364ebc0d930d01a1e13e8d580.png[/img]

[h3][b]Meet the Hogissimus[/b][/h3]

A mad, giant hog with dozens of knives in his back tossing burning barrels at you? Please say “Hail fellow, well met.” to our very first boss in Saga of Sins!

The Hogissimus first attacks from behind a glass wall, which he then shatters with his devastating stomp attack, perfectly fitting to our stained glass art style. But he has even more dirty tricks up his sleeve… 

Will you be able to beat the Hogissimus and finally free the sinners of Gluttony?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42811081/eb5f329d2f14fcd054b4f92f219d0f17c41f33d1.png[/img]

So, what do you say? Does our crazy tavern meet your expectations? And isn’t Gluttony something that easily befalls each and every one of from time to time? Please leave a comment!

Thank you for supporting us by liking, sharing or wish listing,
Your team at Bonus Level Entertainment :)

notes.title: Dev Diary #1 : Werewolf Reveal: Our 1st demonic creature!
notes.notes:
[h2][b]Welcome to Saga of Sins[/b][/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42811081/6fc24e269f09410979bc28e2bc6b977eb90710e8.png[/img]

So, this is it, our first “Saga of Sins” dev diary! Can’t believe we made it this far, as the first concept was written back in 2018 when the game was still called Seven Sins. It is definitely our most anticipated game so far; a lot of time and passion went into this and are we are super excited about the positive feedback we are getting and even more grateful for your support!

First of all, don't forget to come and say hi on our booth at Gamescom! We'll be in Hall 10.2 on the Indie Arena Booth on the Bavaria Games Booth!

[h3][b]Demonic Creatures[/b][/h3]

As you know “Saga of Sins” features four unique demonic creatures, each of them with individual abilities that can be upgraded via a Skill Tree. Once unlocked you can switch between these creatures on the fly and of course there is backtracking too, but it is completely optional. However, if you want to uncover every secret of the game and see all of the four different endings you will need to backtrack and make clever use of your creature’s abilities.    

Some skills however are common to any demonic creature, such as the double jump and the merciless Power Dash!

[h3][b]Power Dash[/b][/h3]

The devastating Power Dash can kill multiple enemies at once. It can be performed in eight directions while standing on the ground or being in midair. But first you will need to fill up your Dash Meter by defeating four enemies! A halo will then indicate that the Power Dash is ready, which is used to shatter your enemies. And the best thing? You will be rewarded with double the amount of gold by killing enemies with your Power Dash!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42811081/029cff7ef1d2e729034682a66615edebb180447a.png[/img]

[h3][b]Beware the Werewolf[/b][/h3]

Finally, let’s dig deeper into the first demonic creature! The Werewolf is a nocturnal demon of the moon, hiding its true form by day, striking at night with no hope for redemption.
His fierce Triple Shot - that can be upgraded - has long range and fast frequency. His special ability is the Revelation Howl.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42811081/23d7fffbdb70093f1df9ff742ac249a4697427f1.png[/img]

[h3][b]Revelation Howl[/b][/h3]

Howling at the moon trained the Werewolf to create sound at a frequency that can shatter cracked glass, revealing hidden treasure chests. And wouldn’t it be just if you could destroy those deceiving mirrors decorating the “Pride” level, the most shimmering sacrilege of the seven deadly sins?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42811081/813e7b968b4bff214df7037203c858a407713c93.png[/img]

[h3][b]Please stay tuned![/b][/h3]

We hope you enjoyed our first dev diary. Please stay tuned for more and keep supporting us by sharing, liking, wish listing or telling a friend of yours about our passionate indie project. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42811081/22662342a4995a18ead5fa5a7e8c3ddf746fe1ca.png[/img]

Thank you so much!
Your Bonus Level Entertainment team :)

Hello sinners and welcome to the very first Steam post about Saga of Sins!

We're blessed to present you our new game, Saga of Sins. 

Saga of Sins, an unholy action-adventure game which features a mystical storyline and a rewarding arcade gameplay.
Play as the righteous cleric Cecil - who can enter people’s minds by transforming into four unique demonic creatures such as a howling werewolf or a fierce gargoyle - to fight the seven deadly sins and free the plague infested village of Sinwell.
